recipes.name: Egg Custard Tarts inspired by Avatar the Last Airbender
ingredients: 1/2 tsp vanilla powder or 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1/2 tsp vanilla powder or 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: For Avatar the Last Airbender Version (Hong Kong Style):
For the Dough
In a food processor, pulse flour, powdered sugar, and butter until the mixture resembles wet sand. - 225 g all purpose flour - 50 g powdered sugar - 9 tbsp unsalted butter
Add beaten egg and pulse until a soft dough forms. Transfer to a bowl, wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate. - 1 large egg beaten
For the Custard
Whisk hot water, sugar, and vanilla in a mixing bowl until combined. - 150 ml hot water - 75 g white sugar - ½ tsp vanilla powder or 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
In a separate mixing bowl, whisk beaten eggs and evaporated milk. - 2 large eggs beaten - 85 ml evaporated milk

Add the water mixture to the egg mixture, whisking thoroughly, and strain through a fine mesh sieve. - 150 ml hot water - 75 g white sugar - ½ tsp vanilla powder or 1/2 tsp vanilla extract - 2 large eggs beaten - 85 ml evaporated milk
For the Assembly
Roll dough on a floured surface with a rolling pin to about 6 mm thickness. Cut into rounds slightly larger than your cupcake tin. - For the Dough
Press the rounds into the tin, leaving a slight overhang above the edges. - For the Dough
Pour custard into each shell, filling ¾ full. Place the tin on a rimmed baking sheet and bake at 400°F for 10 minutes, then reduce to 350°F and bake for 15 minutes until set. - For the Custard
Cool slightly before serving.
For Portuguese Version:
For the Dough

Mix flour and salt in a mixing bowl, then add water and mix until a shaggy dough forms. Let rest on a floured surface, covered with a mixing bowl. - 150 g all purpose flour - 1 g kosher salt - 80 ml water

Roll dough into a square. Spread softened butter over two-thirds of the dough, then fold in thirds. Rotate, roll out again, and repeat with remaining butter. - For the Dough - 113 g unsalted butter softened
Roll the dough tightly into a log, leaving an edge unbuttered. Seal, wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate. - For the Dough
For the Custard
In a saucepan, combine water, sugar, cinnamon stick, and lemon peel. Simmer until sugar dissolves, then cool. - 75 ml water (for syrup) - 1 stick cinnamon - ½ lemon peel - 150 g granulated sugar
In a mixing bowl, mix flour with 1/3rd of the milk until smooth. - 40 g all purpose flour - 1 ½ cups whole milk
Heat the remaining milk in the saucepan until just simmering, then add the flour mixture, whisking constantly until thickened. - 1 ½ cups whole milk

Off heat, stir in the syrup and vanilla. Add the egg yolks while whisking to form a smooth custard. Strain through a fine mesh sieve. - ½ tsp vanilla powder or 1/2 tsp vanilla extract - 6 large eggs yolks only
For the Assembly
Preheat your oven to 500°F with your baking sheet inside.
Slice dough into pieces. Press each piece into a cupcake tin, creating a swirl pattern up the sides. - For the Dough
Fill each pastry shell ¾ full with custard. Bake on a preheated baking sheet in a 500°F oven until the custard is puffed and the pastry is golden brown. - For the Custard - For the Dough
Cool slightly before serving.
